notes: Reports a change to an existing license that doesn't need a transfer: ownership changes inside a corporation, LLC or limited partnership, condition modification or removal, or a change to the premises. Items 1 to 4 and 6 are the licensee's information as it is before the change. change ticks the matching box; 'Other: text' ticks g and writes the text. details is one line; a longer explanation goes on an attached page (the form asks whether one is attached, in the ABC-only block). The signature and date are left for the licensed principal, and the 'For ABC use only' block is never written. The form goes to the district office with the fee from the ABC fee schedule.

lines.en: Licensee's name (an individual's first, middle and last name, or the entity's name), as it is now
lines.zh: 持照人名称（个人填名、中间名、姓；实体填实体名称），按变更前信息填写

lines.en: Doing business as (DBA), as it is now
lines.zh: 营业名称（DBA），按变更前信息填写

lines.en: Premises address (street number and name, city, ZIP code)
lines.zh: 经营场所地址（门牌号和街道名、城市、邮编）
ABC 地区办公室（如 San Jose）

lines.zh: 企业邮寄地址（门牌号和街道名、城市、邮编），按变更前信息填写
